description.value: Olympia Pizza is a Greek-influenced pizza restaurant on West Broadway offering an extensive menu of specialty and custom pizzas alongside pasta, Greek dishes, and appetizers. The restaurant supports both dine-in and online-order pickup, with in-house delivery also available. Weekly wine specials hint at a neighbourhood dining experience that goes beyond a quick slice.
